GROUND RULESREAD BEFORE YOUR PR

PLAY FAIR.
CODE REAL.

Hacktoberfest 26 at GDG IIT Mandi rewards genuine open source work.
These rules keep it fun and fair for everyone.

!

THE GOLDEN RULE

Quality over quantity. Every commit and pull request must be your own genuine, meaningful contribution.

✓ DO

  • Fix real bugs and improve docs
  • Test your changes before pushing
  • Write clear commit messages
  • Explain what and why in your PR
  • Respond to review feedback

× DON'T

  • Spam PRs or empty commits
  • Make whitespace-only changes
  • Copy someone else's work
  • Use bots to farm PRs
  • Open duplicate PRs for one issue
THE RULES

7 THINGS TO KNOW

  1. 01

    Register first

    Sign up on the event page and link your GitHub account. Only registered participants are counted.

  2. 02

    Respect the dates

    Only pull requests opened between Oct 1 and Oct 31, 2026 to the official repo count.

  3. 03

    Claim before you code

    Comment on an issue and wait for a maintainer to assign it. One issue, one pull request.

  4. 04

    Keep it genuine

    No spam, no empty or trivial edits made just to add numbers, and no fake commits.

  5. 05

    Make it your own work

    No plagiarism. If you use AI tools, you must understand and be able to explain every line you submit.

  6. 06

    Follow the project guides

    Read CONTRIBUTING.md and the Code of Conduct. Be kind and respectful in every review and comment.

  7. 07

    Maintainers have the final say

    A PR marked spam or invalid will not count, and maintainer decisions are final.

BREAK THE RULES?

  1. 1

    Warning

    A maintainer flags your PR and asks you to fix it.

  2. 2

    Marked invalid

    The PR is labeled spam and does not count.

  3. 3

    Disqualified

    Repeated spam removes you from the event.
